title: Allure.Net.Sdk configuration
description: Common configuration properties supported by Allure.Net.Sdk. Framework integrations may extend this object with additional properties.

$schema.description: The URL of the JSON Schema used to validate this configuration file.

hostname.description: The host name recorded in generated test results. Defaults to the current machine name.

resultsDirectory.description: The absolute or relative path of the directory where Allure result files are written. Relative paths are resolved against the test process working directory.

linkTemplates.description: Link templates indexed by link type. The {0} substitution field represents the original link value.

failExceptions.description: Exception type names that Allure treats as test failures instead of broken tests.

items.description: The namespace-qualified or assembly-qualified name of an exception type.

indentOutput.description: Whether generated JSON result files are indented.

globalLabels.description: Labels applied to every generated test result, indexed by label name.

runtimeRegistrationHook.description: The assembly-qualified name of the runtime registration hook type.

linkTemplate.title: link template
linkTemplate.description: Templates used to expand a link URL and, optionally, its display name.

urlTemplate.description: A composite format string for the link URL. The {0} substitution field represents the original link value.

nameTemplate.description: An optional composite format string for the link display name. The {0} substitution field represents the original link value.
